text.style: font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2d2e2d

g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: Average time spent on different activities in a 24-hour day by people aged 15 to 64, according to each

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: country's most recent time-use survey in the OECD database over the period 2010–2024.

font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Averages cover everyone aged 15 to 64, on weekdays and weekends alike. Days off and people not working or studying count as zero hours of paid

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: work and study. Unpaid work also includes religious and civic activities, and time the OECD doesn't assign to another category, including some travel.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Data source: OECD Time Use Database (2026)
